full_judgment: In response, each of the Petitioners individually submitted written objections in respect of the requisition and acquisition of property measuring 6.96 acres of Mouza No. 144 Ati, Siddirgonj, District-Narayanganj as more fully and collectively described in the schedules to the notices. These objections were sent by the Petitioners in their capacities variously as owners and possessors of the said property, some by way of inheritance, some by virtue of purchase (Annexure-'B' series). The Petitioners also submitted a joint written objection reiterating the common averments made in their individual written objections (Annexure-'C'). It is stated that notwithstanding these objections made, the Respondent No. 3 without considering the same sent a report dated 31-1-2005 to the Respondent No. 2, Commissioner, Dhaka Division for a final decision under Section 5(1) of the Ordinance for the purpose of constructing residential Qumters for the Dhaka Reporters Unit Multipurpose Co-operative Society Limited (Annexure-'D'). The Petitioners submit that this was done illegally an without any lawful authority. In this regard it is stated in particular that the concerned requiring body did not enter into an agreement with the Government in such prescribed form as is otherwise required under Section 15(1) of the Ordinance prior to the publication of the preliminary notice of acquisition of the property variously issued to the Petitioners under Section 3 of the Ordinance (Annexure-'A' series).
